score_semantics: Declaration of director source quality E, scoped warrant C, generalization G, priority L, not calibrated truth probabilities.

evidence.scope: 2024 GBIF 29543 original row and original publisher source audit, closed MQR 4.95
evidence.limitation: 2024 source ZIP not read directly this turn; document confirms original fields gbifID, datasetKey, occurrenceID, status, coords, year but does not certify eventID/locationID/samplingEffort population.

evidence.scope: GBIF original occurrence ZIP optional eventID, locationID, eventDate and sampling effort schema
evidence.limitation: This is schema availability, not proof these fields are populated in the historical particular 2024 archive.

evidence.scope: GBIF sampling-event data quality requirements and eventID continuity
evidence.limitation: Same GBIF standards family as E02; do not treat as independent data root. Standard requires event semantics, not biological closure proof.

evidence.scope: 2001 NAAMP original P. crucifer and P. feriarum observation root 337 station visits/130 sites
evidence.limitation: Original 2001 single program, two frog species share 337 field visits, not 674 independent survey events and not Finnish Anemone sites.

evidence.scope: unmarked vignette field key RouteNumStopNum and visits per site in 2001 frogs
evidence.limitation: Official package documentation, shares NAAMP original site observations with E04; not new independent sample.

evidence.scope: R112 explicitly fail-closed GBIF occurrence event metadata screening implementation
evidence.limitation: Only an independent local analogous script ran synthetic fixture; GitHub-byte-identical R112 execution and 2024 real ZIP inspection are NOT verified.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Publisher’s 4.95 CSV lacks event and physical-site identity columns; cannot validate repeats from author 23-column table
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Publisher CSV columns: lat, long, presence, year, 19 bio; no eventID/locationID or effort; original GBIF core may carry optional fields.

claims_and_decisions.claim: GBIF published occurrence ZIP schema can expose eventID, locationID, eventDate, samplingProtocol, samplingEffort
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Schema availability only; do not infer per-record fill rates.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Original 2024 GBIF 29543 rows already verified to contain complete eventID/locationID/effort/same-site repeats
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Historical archive header/field-value completeness not examined this turn.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Duplicate year and coordinates alone certify a repeat visit at same physical site
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Temporal and geographic aggregates do not certify event/visit, distinct sampling programs or measurement unit.

claims_and_decisions.claim: 2001 NAAMP data contain documented real revisits in same sampling program, 337 visits 130 sites
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Other frog species and country; cannot identify Finnish Anemone closed-site q/d.

claims_and_decisions.claim: R112 event scanner proves from original GBIF ZIP that appropriate repeat visits exist
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Only synthetic fixture was locally run on analogous source; original 2024 ZIP not fetched or executed.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Preserve true raw ZIP source-file acquisition/audit as next gate, not another retrospective status-only score
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Without event and effort metadata, occupancy mechanism cannot be adjudicated.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Treat 4.97 frogs as a methodological contrast but never as independent calibration of Finnish 4.95 Anemone
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Different years, places, organisms, underlying observation regimes.

claims_and_decisions.claim: Maintain Faraday–Maxwell historical Q4/Q7 research while prioritizing genuine original data provenance in Q2
claims_and_decisions.limitation: Programmatic choice, not empirically verified novel theory.

gates: Original 2024 ZIP bytes and 29543 records must be checked at known public SHA/custody root.
Tabular eventID/locationID/eventDate and source samplingProtocol/effort can be missing; no invented positive count.
Multiple eventIDs alone prove only multiple event codes, not distinct independent stable same-site physical visits.
Site-frame and organism, sampling season, closure and missingness must be checked before q/d modeling.
Only an independently testable difference beyond conventional GBIF/occupancy methods can support MQR scientific novelty.
